DeepData REST API v1.0.3 · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST. Base URL: root URL including the application context path, e.g. https://deepdata.example.com/ems-site.

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "your_user",
  "password": "your_password",
  "timezone": "Europe/Madrid",
  "idLanguage": "es",
  "max_vars_per_call": 5
}
  • username: DeepData login user.
  • password: DeepData login password.
  • timezone: Default IANA timezone. Can be overridden per installation.
  • idLanguage: Language code for catalog labels (default: es). Use getIdiomas to find available values.
  • max_vars_per_call: Maximum number of variables per getMedidas API call (default: 5). The API rejects requests with too many variables (REST0012) and that failed attempt triggers a 24 h cooldown (REST0013). Pre-splitting avoids hitting the limit.

2) Authentication

The Login action performs GET /rest/login?user=…&pass=… (note: the parameter is pass, not password).

The JSON response body contains:

  • jsessionid: session token (~30 min validity).
  • name: display name of the authenticated user.

All subsequent requests must include the header: Cookie: JSESSIONID=<value>.

If the session expires, the API returns error code REST0003. The import procedure detects this and performs an automatic re-login (max 3 times).

3) Hierarchical Catalog Model

DeepData Instance
├── Idioma (language)
├── Categoría (category of variables)
└── Instalación (installation / site)
    └── Punto de Medida (measure point) ──► mdm.measurement.device
        └── Variable (sensor variable)  ──► mdm.measurement.device.sensor
            ├── type: Acumulativa / Demandada / Instantanea
            └── unit: measurement unit

4) Catalog Endpoints (Sync Procedure)

StepMethodEndpointBody (Content-Type: text/plain)
1GET/rest/getIdiomas—
2GET/rest/getInstalaciones—
3POST/rest/getCategorias{"idLanguage":"es"}
4POST/rest/getPuntosMedida (loop per installation){"idLanguage":"es","idInstallation":1}
5POST/rest/getVariables (loop per measure point){"idLanguage":"es","idInstallation":1,"idMeasurePoint":10}

The catalog sync is idempotent — it can be run multiple times without duplicating data. It produces a JSON attachment with the full hierarchy for review.

5) Measures Endpoint (Import Procedure)

Request:

POST /rest/getMedidas
Content-Type: text/plain
Cookie: JSESSIONID=<value>

{
  "startDate": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:SS",
  "endDate":   "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:SS",
  "idLanguage": "es",
  "listInstallation": [
    {
      "idInstallation": 105,
      "listMeasurePoint": [
        {
          "idMeasurePoint": 1165,
          "timeZone": "Atlantic/Canary",
          "listVariables": [1, 2, 3]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Note: Dates are sent in the local timezone of the request, without UTC conversion. timeZone per measure point is optional (defaults to the installation timezone).

Response:

[
  {
    "date": "01-11-2023 00:00:00",
    "listValue": [
      {
        "idInstallation": "105",
        "idMeasurePoint": "1165",
        "idVariable": "1",
        "value": 23.5
      }
    ]
  }
]

Note: date is a string in DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS format. idInstallation, idMeasurePoint and idVariable are strings (not integers).

6) Error Handling

CodeDescriptionAction
REST0003Session expired / invalid cookieAutomatic re-login and retry (max 3)
REST0002Missing parametersLog and skip
REST0007Incorrect JSON formatLog and skip
REST0009Error consulting measuresRetry once with backoff (5 s)
REST0011No data availableLog as info, continue
REST0012Too many variables in requestSplit variable set in half, retry
REST0013Measures queried, available in 24hLog and abort — do NOT retry

7) Odoo Configuration

Device (mdm.measurement.device) remotecontrol_params:

Each device represents a DeepData measure point within an installation.

Minimum (required):

{
  "installation_id": 1,
  "measure_point_id": 10
}

Full (with optional fields):

{
  "installation_id": 1,
  "installation_name": "Porzuna",
  "measure_point_id": 10,
  "measure_point_name": "General Porzuna 1",
  "timezone": "Europe/Madrid",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"
}
  • installation_id: Required. DeepData installation identifier.
  • measure_point_id: Required. DeepData measure point identifier.
  • installation_name: Optional. Display name of the installation.
  • measure_point_name: Optional. Display name of the measure point.
  • timezone: Optional. IANA timezone for this installation. Defaults to the one in connection_params.
  • start_date: Optional. Start date for first data retrieval. Defaults to Jan 1st of current year.

Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) remotecontrol_params:

Each sensor represents a DeepData variable within the measure point (device).

Minimum (required):

{
  "variable_id": 100
}

Full (with optional fields):

{
  "variable_id": 100,
  "variable_name": "Energia Activa",
  "variable_type": "Acumulativa",
  "variable_unit": "kWh",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"
}
  • variable_id: Required. DeepData variable identifier.
  • variable_name: Optional. Display name of the variable.
  • variable_type: Optional. DeepData variable type (Acumulativa, Demandada, etc.).
  • variable_unit: Optional. Measurement unit (kWh, kVArh, etc.).
  • start_date: Optional. Overrides device start_date if provided.

8) Operational Flow

  1. Catalog Sync (run once / periodically): Login → getIdiomas → getInstalaciones → getCategorias → getPuntosMedida (loop per installation) → getVariables (loop per measure point). Produces a hierarchy JSON attachment for reference.
  2. Measure Import (daily / scheduled): Login → Build plan from Odoo devices → getMedidas (per installation, all variables batched) → Upsert readings. Handles automatic re-login, variable splitting and structured error recovery.

9) Technical Notes

  • jsessionid is returned in the JSON response body of /rest/login — not in a cookie.
  • Login query parameter is pass (not password).
  • All POST bodies use Content-Type: text/plain with a JSON string as body.
  • Session is ephemeral — not persisted between executions (~30 min validity).
  • date in getMedidas response is a string in DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS format (converted to YYYY-MM-DD for Odoo).
  • REST0012 = too many variables → variable set is split in half per measure point, not the date range.
  • REST0013 = measures already queried → do NOT retry; log and skip.
  • Idempotent readings via upsert(sensor_id, measurement_time).
  • Audit JSON attachment created after each execution.

# ── DeepData Catalog Sync ────────────────────────────────────────────── # GET getIdiomas, GET getInstalaciones. # POST getCategorias (text/plain, idLanguage). # POST getPuntosMed per installation (text/plain, idLanguage + idInstallation). # POST getVariables per measure point (text/plain, idLanguage + idInstallation + idMeasurePoint). # Produces an audit JSON attachment with the full hierarchy. # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── import time as _time
Remote = self.remote_id jsessionid = bag.get('jsessionid') id_language = bag.get('idLanguage', 'es')
if not jsessionid: raise Exception("Missing JSESSIONID in bag. Run Login action first.")
api_base = (base_url or '').rstrip('/') hdrs_get = { 'Cookie': 'JSESSIONID=%s' % jsessionid, 'Accept': 'application/json', } hdrs_post = { 'Cookie': 'JSESSIONID=%s' % jsessionid, 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Accept': 'application/json', }
def _get(endpoint, label): url = '%s/rest/%s' % (api_base, endpoint) resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=hdrs_get, timeout=timeout) if resp.status_code >= 400: raise Exception( "DeepData %s: HTTP %s - %s" % ( label, resp.status_code, (resp.text or '')[:500])) # Check if response is HTML (error page) content_type = resp.headers.get('Content-Type', '') if 'text/html' in content_type: raise Exception( "DeepData %s: Server returned HTML error page (session may have expired)" % label) try: body = resp.json() except Exception: raise Exception("DeepData %s: invalid JSON response" % label) if isinstance(body, dict) and (body.get('codigo') or body.get('errorCode')): ec = body.get('codigo') or body.get('errorCode') em = body.get('mensaje') or body.get('errorMessage', '') if ec == 'REST0003': raise Exception( "SESSION_EXPIRED: session expired during %s" % label) raise Exception( "DeepData %s: %s - %s" % (label, ec, em)) return body
def _post(endpoint, payload_dict, label): url = '%s/rest/%s' % (api_base, endpoint) resp = request_retry( 'POST', url, data=json.dumps(payload_dict), headers=hdrs_post, timeout=timeout) if resp.status_code >= 400: raise Exception( "DeepData %s: HTTP %s - %s" % ( label, resp.status_code, (resp.text or '')[:500])) # Check if response is HTML (error page) content_type = resp.headers.get('Content-Type', '') if 'text/html' in content_type: raise Exception( "DeepData %s: Server returned HTML error page (session may have expired)" % label) try: body = resp.json() except Exception: raise Exception("DeepData %s: invalid JSON response" % label) if isinstance(body, dict) and (body.get('codigo') or body.get('errorCode')): ec = body.get('codigo') or body.get('errorCode') em = body.get('mensaje') or body.get('errorMessage', '') if ec == 'REST0003': raise Exception( "SESSION_EXPIRED: session expired during %s" % label) raise Exception( "DeepData %s: %s - %s" % (label, ec, em)) return body
def _to_list(raw, key=None): if isinstance(raw, list): return raw if isinstance(raw, dict): return raw.get(key, []) if key else [] return []
# ── 1. getIdiomas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── idiomas = _to_list(_get('getIdiomas', 'getIdiomas')) _time.sleep(0.3)
# ── 2. getInstalaciones ──────────────────────────────────────────────── instalaciones = _to_list( _get('getInstalaciones', 'getInstalaciones'), 'instalaciones') _time.sleep(0.3)
# ── 3. getCategorias (POST, text/plain) ──────────────────────────────── cat_raw = _post('getCategorias', {'idLanguage': id_language}, 'getCategorias') categorias = _to_list(cat_raw, 'categorias') cat_map = {} for cat in categorias: if isinstance(cat, dict): cid = cat.get('idCategory') if cid is not None: cat_map[cid] = { 'id': cid, 'name': cat.get('nameCategory', ''), 'description': cat.get('descriptionCategory', ''), } _time.sleep(0.3)
# ── 4+5. getPuntosMed per installation + getVariables per point ──────── hierarchy = [] for inst in instalaciones: if not isinstance(inst, dict): continue inst_id = inst.get('idInstallation') if inst_id is None: continue inst_entry = { 'id': inst_id, 'name': inst.get('nameInstallation', ''), 'description': inst.get('descriptionInstallation', ''), 'timezone': inst.get('timeZone', ''), 'measure_points': [], }
# POST getPuntosMedida for this installation try: pm_raw = _post( 'getPuntosMedida', {'idLanguage': id_language, 'idInstallation': inst_id}, 'getPuntosMedida[inst=%s]' % inst_id) puntos = _to_list(pm_raw, 'puntosMedida') _time.sleep(0.2) # ── Deduplication ─────────────────────────────────────────── # The DeepData getPuntosMedida endpoint returns duplicate # entries for the same idMeasurePoint (observed: 3 unique # points repeated 13× = 39 rows). We skip already-seen IDs # to avoid inflated counts and redundant getVariables calls. # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── seen_pm_ids = set() for pm in puntos: if not isinstance(pm, dict): continue pm_id = pm.get('idMeasurePoint') if pm_id is None: continue if pm_id in seen_pm_ids: continue seen_pm_ids.add(pm_id) # ── Category extraction ────────────────────────────────── # The API nests the category inside the measure point as: # {"category": {"idCategory": 1}} # instead of a flat "idCategory" field at root level. # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── pm_cat_raw = pm.get('category') if isinstance(pm_cat_raw, dict): pm_cat_id = pm_cat_raw.get('idCategory') else: pm_cat_id = pm.get('idCategory') pm_entry = { 'id': pm_id, 'name': pm.get('nameMeasurePoint', ''), 'description': pm.get('descriptionMeasurePoint', ''), 'category_id': pm_cat_id, 'category_name': cat_map.get( pm_cat_id, {}).get('name', '') if pm_cat_id else '', 'variables': [], }
# POST getVariables for this measure point try: var_raw = _post( 'getVariables', { 'idLanguage': id_language, 'idInstallation': inst_id, 'idMeasurePoint': pm_id, }, 'getVariables[inst=%s,pm=%s]' % (inst_id, pm_id)) variables = _to_list(var_raw, 'variables') _time.sleep(0.2) # Deduplicate variables by idVariable (defensive: # same API pattern as getPuntosMedida). seen_var_ids = set() for var in variables: if not isinstance(var, dict): continue vid = var.get('idVariable') if vid is None: continue if vid in seen_var_ids: continue seen_var_ids.add(vid) pm_entry['variables'].append({ 'id': vid, 'name': var.get('nameVariable', ''), 'short_name': var.get('shortNameVariable', ''), 'type': var.get('typeVariable', ''), 'unit': var.get('unitVariable', ''), }) except Exception as ve: pm_entry['variables_error'] = str(ve)
inst_entry['measure_points'].append(pm_entry) except Exception as pe: inst_entry['measure_points_error'] = str(pe)
hierarchy.append(inst_entry)
# Summary total_inst = len(hierarchy) total_pm = sum(len(i['measure_points']) for i in hierarchy) total_var = sum( len(mp['variables']) for i in hierarchy for mp in i['measure_points'] )
# ── Create audit attachment ──────────────────────────────────────────── catalog = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'id_language': id_language, 'languages': idiomas, 'categories': list(cat_map.values()), 'hierarchy': hierarchy, 'summary': { 'total_installations': total_inst, 'total_measure_points': total_pm, 'total_variables': total_var, 'total_categories': len(cat_map), } }
json_str = json.dumps(catalog, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) encoded = base64.b64encode(json_str.encode('utf-8')) fname = 'deepdata_catalog_%s.json' % ( fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_'))
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': encoded, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post( body=u'[DeepData] Catalog sync: installations=%s measure_points=%s ' u'variables=%s categories=%s lang=%s' % ( total_inst, total_pm, total_var, len(cat_map), id_language), attachment_ids=[att.id], )
bag['catalog'] = catalog bag['hierarchy'] = hierarchy bag['catalog_attachment_id'] = att.id bag['catalog_attachment_name'] = fname

# ── DeepData: Provision Devices ──────────────────────────────────────── # Auto-creates mdm.measurement.device and mdm.measurement.device.sensor # records from the catalog hierarchy obtained in the previous step. # # Hierarchy mapping: # DeepData measure point → one mdm device # DeepData variable → one mdm sensor (under its device) # # Each device stores both the installation and measure point identifiers # in remotecontrol_params so the import pipeline can reconstruct the # getMedidas payload (which groups by installation). # # Idempotent: existing devices are matched by (installation_id, # measure_point_id) in their remotecontrol_params; sensors by # (device_id, variable_id). # # Sensor types and UOMs are auto-created (find-or-create) based on the # variable metadata returned by the API (unit + type). # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Remote = self.remote_id hierarchy = bag.get('hierarchy') or []
if not hierarchy: raise Exception( "No hierarchy in bag. Run Sync Catalog action first.")
Device = env['mdm.measurement.device'] Sensor = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] SensorType = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor.type'] SensorUom = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor.uom']
# Resolve the remotecontrol xmlid for linking devices remotecontrol_ref = env.ref('remotecontrol_deepdata.remotecontrol_deepdata')
cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(Remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {} default_tz = cfg.get('timezone', 'Europe/Madrid')
# ── UOM cache: find or create by name ────────────────────────────────── uom_cache = {} # unit_name -> record
def _get_uom(unit_name): if not unit_name: unit_name = u'-' if unit_name in uom_cache: return uom_cache[unit_name] uom = SensorUom.search([('name', '=', unit_name)], limit=1) if not uom: uom = SensorUom.create({ 'name': unit_name, 'abbreviation': unit_name, 'description': u'Auto-created from DeepData (unit: %s)' % unit_name, }) uom_cache[unit_name] = uom return uom
# ── Sensor Type cache: find or create by composite name ─────────────── # mdm.measurement.device.sensor.type has unique(name), so we build a # composite name "Type (Unit)" to allow the same DeepData type with # different units (e.g. "Acumulativa (kWh)" vs "Acumulativa (kVArh)"). type_cache = {} # full_name -> record
def _get_sensor_type(type_name, uom): if not type_name: type_name = u'General' full_name = u'%s (%s)' % (type_name, uom.name) if full_name in type_cache: return type_cache[full_name] stype = SensorType.search([('name', '=', full_name)], limit=1) if not stype: stype = SensorType.create({ 'name': full_name, 'description': u'Auto-created from DeepData (%s)' % type_name, 'uom_id': uom.id, }) type_cache[full_name] = stype return stype
# ── Build map of existing devices by (installation_id, measure_point_id) # Each device represents one DeepData measure point inside an installation. existing_devices = {} # (installation_id, measure_point_id) -> device record all_devices = Device.search([ ('remotecontrol_id', '=', remotecontrol_ref.id), ]) for dev in all_devices: try: dev_cfg = json.loads(dev.remotecontrol_params or '{}') except Exception: dev_cfg = {} iid = dev_cfg.get('installation_id') mpid = dev_cfg.get('measure_point_id') if iid is not None and mpid is not None: existing_devices[(int(iid), int(mpid))] = dev
# ── Build map of existing sensors by (device_id, variable_id) ───────── # Since each device already represents a specific measure point, the # sensor only needs the variable_id to be unique within its device. existing_sensors = {} # (device_id, variable_id) -> sensor record all_sensors = Sensor.search([ ('remotecontrol_id', '=', remotecontrol_ref.id), ]) for sen in all_sensors: try: sen_cfg = json.loads(sen.remotecontrol_params or '{}') except Exception: sen_cfg = {} var_id = sen_cfg.get('variable_id') if var_id is not None: existing_sensors[(sen.device_id.id, int(var_id))] = sen
total_devices_created = 0 total_devices_existing = 0 total_sensors_created = 0 total_sensors_existing = 0 total_uom_created = len(uom_cache) # updated later total_types_created = len(type_cache) # updated later device_details = []
for inst in hierarchy: if not isinstance(inst, dict): continue inst_id = inst.get('id') if inst_id is None: continue
inst_name = inst.get('name') or ('Installation %s' % inst_id) inst_tz = inst.get('timezone') or default_tz
# ── One device per measure point ─────────────────────────────── for mp in inst.get('measure_points', []): if not isinstance(mp, dict): continue mp_id = mp.get('id') if mp_id is None: continue mp_name = mp.get('name') or ('MP %s' % mp_id)
dev_key = (int(inst_id), int(mp_id)) device = existing_devices.get(dev_key) if device: total_devices_existing += 1 else: device = Device.create({ 'name': mp_name, 'description': u'%s · %s' % (inst_name, mp_name), 'remotecontrol_id': remotecontrol_ref.id, 'remotecontrol_params': json.dumps({ 'installation_id': inst_id, 'installation_name': inst_name, 'measure_point_id': mp_id, 'measure_point_name': mp_name, 'timezone': inst_tz, }, ensure_ascii=False), }) existing_devices[dev_key] = device total_devices_created += 1
dev_sensors_created = 0 dev_sensors_existing = 0
# ── One sensor per variable ──────────────────────────────── for var in mp.get('variables', []): if not isinstance(var, dict): continue var_id = var.get('id') if var_id is None: continue
sensor_key = (device.id, int(var_id)) if sensor_key in existing_sensors: dev_sensors_existing += 1 total_sensors_existing += 1 continue
# ── Resolve UOM and Sensor Type ──────────────────────── unit_name = var.get('unit', '') var_type = var.get('type', '') uom = _get_uom(unit_name) stype = _get_sensor_type(var_type, uom)
var_name = var.get('name') or var.get('short_name') or ('Var %s' % var_id)
sensor = Sensor.create({ 'name': var_name, 'device_id': device.id, 'type_id': stype.id, 'remotecontrol_params': json.dumps({ 'variable_id': var_id, 'variable_name': var.get('name', ''), 'variable_type': var_type, 'variable_unit': unit_name, }, ensure_ascii=False), }) existing_sensors[sensor_key] = sensor dev_sensors_created += 1 total_sensors_created += 1
device_details.append({ 'installation_id': inst_id, 'measure_point_id': mp_id, 'device_name': mp_name, 'device_id': device.id, 'sensors_created': dev_sensors_created, 'sensors_existing': dev_sensors_existing, })
total_uom_created = len(uom_cache) total_types_created = len(type_cache)
# ── Create audit attachment ──────────────────────────────────────────── audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_devices_created': total_devices_created, 'total_devices_existing': total_devices_existing, 'total_sensors_created': total_sensors_created, 'total_sensors_existing': total_sensors_existing, 'total_uom_in_cache': total_uom_created, 'total_sensor_types_in_cache': total_types_created, 'devices': device_details, }
b64 = base64.b64encode( json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'deepdata_provision_%s.json' % ( fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_'))
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post( body=u'[DeepData] Provision: devices_created=%s devices_existing=%s ' u'sensors_created=%s sensors_existing=%s uoms=%s types=%s' % ( total_devices_created, total_devices_existing, total_sensors_created, total_sensors_existing, total_uom_created, total_types_created), attachment_ids=[att.id], )
bag['provision_audit'] = audit bag['provision_attachment_id'] = att.id
